title: 19h Sitting of first session of 2026
summary: The sitting due to start at 9:00 could not begin because there was no quorum, so the chair postponed the start to 10:00. At 10:00 quorum was still missing, so the Deputy Speaker cancelled the sitting under Rule 49(b) and said the next sitting would be at 9:00 the following day, 14 May 2026. The minutes list 9 members present, 7 on official travel, 13 more not attending for a reason that is garbled in the text, and 63 who neither took leave nor informed the chair; no business was taken and no votes were held.

items.title: Start of sitting postponed for lack of quorum
Sitting cancelled for lack of quorum (Rule 49(b))
items.outcome: cancelled; next sitting set for 9:00 on 14 May 2026

items.title: Attendance record
items.outcome: 9 present, 7 on official travel, 63 absent without leave or notice

decisions: The sitting was postponed from 9:00 to 10:00 because quorum was not met.
At 10:00 quorum was still not met, so the sitting was cancelled under Rule 49(b) of the Majlis rules.
The next sitting was scheduled for 9:00 on 14 May 2026.
